content:
#1 I am trying to make the nForum responsive (see style).

However the website lacks the basic head tag:

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

which is responsible for having media queries work on mobile. So the style works on resized desktop browser but will not work on a real mobile device. It is also the cause of the nForum website feeling “unzoomed” on mobile.
subject: nForum missing html meta viewport tag

content: #2 Thanks for the suggestion. I have forwarded this request to our technical team. Somebody will update here.
